title: How Many All-Time Wins Does Oklahoma Football Have?
question: How many all-time wins does Oklahoma football have, and where does it rank?
answer: Through the 2025 season, Oklahoma's all-time record was 960-351-53, a winning percentage of about .723. The Sooners rank sixth in major college football history in both total wins and winning percentage.
summary: Oklahoma football went 960-351-53 through 2025, sixth in college football history in wins and win rate. See which coaches won the most games.
body: Through the 2025 season, Oklahoma's all-time record stood at 960 wins, 351 losses and 53 ties, a winning percentage of roughly .723. The Sooners rank sixth among major college programs in total victories and also sixth in winning percentage.

The win column dates to 1895, when the Sooners lost their only game under Jack Harts. Bennie Owen built the program's foundation with 122 wins from 1905 to 1926, but the totals really took off after World War II.

Three coaches account for nearly half of all the wins. Bob Stoops leads the program with 191 victories, Barry Switzer is second with 157 and Bud Wilkinson third with 145. Lincoln Riley went 55-10 from 2017 to 2021, a better winning percentage than any of them.

The most recent chapter added to the pile. Brent Venables's teams went 32-20 from 2022 through 2025, capped by a 10-3 season in 2025 that included a College Football Playoff home game against Alabama.

Fans may see totals that differ by a game or two between record books, since sources handle a few results differently. Adding up the coaching records on SoonerStats gives 960 wins through 2025; Wikipedia and Winsipedia show 965 with the 2026 season in progress, which matches once the Sooners' 5-4 start to 2026 is set aside.
